chapter_title: Case Studies B — Qwen 2.5/3, OLMo 2/3, Phi 3/4
course_outline_concepts: Qwen 2.5: 1M SFT + 150K DPO pairs; LR 7e-7, Online Merging Optimizer
Qwen 3 hybrid-thinking: single-model-two-modes training — data labeling to enable toggling
OLMo 2 (Tülu-recipe) vs OLMo 3 (model-flow): what the open stages look like
Phi 3/4 synthetic-heavy SFT — pretrain/SFT boundary blurring
Phi-4-reasoning: long-CoT SFT on top and measured impact

sources.what_to_extract: 1M SFT examples + two-stage context curriculum (Phase 1 ≤32K / Phase 2 mixed up to 262K); 150K DPO pairs via SFT-resample + quality filter; Online Merging Optimizer; DPO LR 7e-7, 1 epoch; GRPO with variance-ordered prompts.

Unified thinking/non-thinking framework; long-CoT cold-start SFT; four-stage post-training (long-CoT SFT → reasoning RL → thinking-mode fusion → general RL); strong-to-weak distillation for small models; thinking-budget interface.
Qwen 3.5 inherits the Qwen 3 four-stage recipe; post-training algorithmic changes not disclosed; 397B-A17B MoE, 1M context, on-device Small series; decoding speedup is inference-level, not SFT.

Tülu 3 recipe adopted wholesale (SFT on OLMo-variant Tülu 3 mix ~939K prompts → DPO → RLVR); architecture stability (RMSNorm reorder + QK-Norm + Z-loss); two-stage pretraining (OLMo-Mix-1124 then Dolmino); 7B/13B/32B.

Model-flow as the artifact: Base/Think/Instruct/RL Zero branches from one base; three-stage base (pretrain → mid-training → long-context); Dolci post-training suite with SFT/DPO/RLVR mixes; 8× SFT throughput after moving to Olmo Core.

Two-phase pretraining (web-heavy → synthetic-heavy) that blurs pretrain/SFT; SFT on curated synthetic + human-written pairs; DPO with dedicated safety slice; phi-3-mini 3.8B reaches Mixtral 8x7B parity on some benchmarks.

Phi-4 base: 400B unweighted synthetic tokens across 50 categories + pivotal-token DPO; Phi-4-reasoning: 1.4M prompts filtered to 'boundary of base-model capability', ~16B token (8.3B unique) long-CoT traces from o3-mini at 32K, then 90 GRPO steps with length-aware reward + n-gram repetition penalty; +10% AIME from RL.
Textbook-quality ancestor to Phi-3/4; 20K-topic taxonomy for synthesis; 20B synthetic tokens + 7B phi-1 code data; data-not-public reproducibility ceiling.
Original phi-1: filtered web + synthetic textbooks (6B + 1B); pedagogical classifier; HumanEval contamination critique that carries through the Phi line.
Qwen team post-training signature: two-stage SFT context curriculum + Online Merging Optimizer (DPO stabilizer) + variance-ordered GRPO; Qwen is the de-facto base for distilled R1 students.
AllenAI worldview: data as first-class artifact; post-training modular (SFT → DPO → RLVR); release paths, not endpoints; OLMES steers development; OLMo 3's model-flow is the scientific artifact.
